description: A tabbed dock beside the chat for a shell, Git changes and other mods' panels, with focus keys, resize keys, screen modes and a panel registry

border.title: Panel frame
border.description: Corner and line style of the panel frames

side.title: Dock side
side.description: Which side of the chat the panels sit on

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: tabs: one dock with a tab per panel; stack: panels stacked in splits

dock_size.title: Dock width (%)
dock_size.description: Share of the width the panels take, 15 to 85; resizing overrides it until /workspace reset

narrow_below.title: Narrow below (columns)
narrow_below.description: Below this width the panels move below the chat (above it on the left side)

panels.title: Panel order
panels.description: Panel ids separated by commas, such as changes, terminal; panels left out are hidden and unknown ids show in /workspace config; empty shows built-ins, then registered panels

key_panel_1.title: Key: show panel 1
key_panel_1.description: A character, a named key (Left, Home), F2-F12, or Ctrl+x / Alt+x; <disabled> turns it off
